patch_description: Add targeted two-switch moves that insert links from other high-quality, already-scored networks into the current parent. For a desired link (a, b), the move finds a parent link (a, x) and a parent link (y, b), then replaces them with (a, b) and (y, x). This preserves every node’s in- and out-degree, and the existing validity filter rejects self-loops or duplicate links. These moves let the search systematically explore transitions toward elite networks instead of relying only on random swaps and rotations to discover their useful structure. They are screened and budgeted by the existing search machinery.
